mods.name: Extra Backpack
mods.description: An optional native 20-slot extra backpack for every character class.
mods.author: zj1022

mods.name: 控制通货
mods.description: 控制每次击杀掉什么通货：逐项设定数量、对哪些怪物生效，以及是否保留服务端自己的掉落。
mods.author: mingyue8621

mods.name: 惊喜物品
mods.description: 魔法、稀有、传奇掉落都有小概率带上这些效果：把某件传奇的词缀当成额外固定词缀、把已有词缀强化到原值的 1.1~2 倍、或者比本该有的多给一条词缀并破碎住它所在的半边（前缀或后缀）。三种效果可以同时落在一件物品上。
mods.author: marshmellion

mods.name: Fast Campaign
mods.description: A faster campaign: 5x kill experience, +50% movement speed, and /fast lists the commands that skip ahead.
mods.author: LocalExile

mods.name: Global Chat
mods.description: Talk to other LocalExile players: global, trade and whisper chat go through the LocalExile global chat server.
mods.author: JetStream

mods.name: GM Commands
mods.description: The development and testing chat commands: teleport, items, monsters, experience, quest flags, test hits and protocol probes.
mods.author: LocalExile

mods.name: Item Quantity
mods.description: 10 times as many item drops from every kill.
mods.author: LocalExile

mods.name: Item Rarity
mods.description: Magic, rare and unique equipment each drop more often, with a multiplier of its own.
mods.author: LocalExile

mods.name: Live Economy
mods.description: Faustus's Currency Exchange as a live market: the official Path of Exile leagues' prices, a spread, depth, and orders that fill with time.
mods.author: JetStream

mods.name: 物品过滤器
mods.description: 自带剑心（七档）、一乐（八档，小结巴音效）、文子（六档，物价版）三套物品过滤器，都已换算成本服 3.29 的客户端数据（3.30 专属的「Fated 命运装备」条件块已剔除，老版类名与通配写法已按 3.29 展开，客户端认不出的隐藏/退役物品也剔掉了——比如空类下的 Growing Wombgift、Hidden Items 类下的 Random XXX Idol，留着会让整份过滤器读取失败），按你选的档位在客户端里选中。
mods.author: mingyue8621

mods.name: 地图掉落
mods.description: 控制每次击杀掉多少地图：按怪物稀有度给概率，掉落与当前地图同阶（或固定阶数），首领必掉。
mods.author: mingyue8621

mods.name: Pet Loot
mods.description: Worn pets collect selected currency with per-character filters and an immediate pause switch.
mods.author: zj1022

mods.name: POB
mods.description: Preview and import a character build through a configured external PoB converter（提示已汉化）
mods.author: nikolos89

mods.name: 孔位控制
mods.description: 手动决定掉落装备的孔数与连接：孔数、几连都能设成区间随机或固定值，还能选只保底、只封顶，以及孔的颜色。
mods.author: mingyue8621

mods.name: Waypoint Tools
mods.description: Lets Waypoint's tools reach the game without the client control bridge: the item crafter gives its items through it.
mods.author: Waypoint

mods.name: Zoom
mods.description: A wider view in normal play: the camera stands further back, and /zoom sets how far.
mods.author: evrydayjunglist
